 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Nov 2, 2026, 12:30 IST CISCE to release the ICSE, ISC time tables 2027 soon ICSE , ISC Date Sheet 2027: The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE) is expected to release the ICSE, ISC date sheet 2027 in the last week of November 2026. Last year, the date sheet came out on November 13, 2025 . The ICSE exam 2027 for 10th Class are expected to be held between February and March 2027. The ISC 2027 exam for 12th Class will take place from February to April 2027.
 The CISCE date sheet 2027 will be shared as a PDF on the official website, cisce.org. The PDF will share subject-wise exam dates, exam timings and other important instructions. Students should check the ICSE ISC time table 2027 to plan their study schedule well. Read below to know more about ICSE, ISC Date Sheet 2027 .
 Steps to download ICSE, ISC date sheet 2027
 Students can download ICSE, ISC time table 2027 by following the steps shared below.
 Visit the official CISCE website- cisce.org.
 Click on ICSE, ISC Date Sheet 2027 link
 Select the class
 CISCE Date Sheet 2027 PDF will open on the screen.
 Download the PDF and save it
 ICSE Date Sheet 2027 
 ICSE timetable is released by CISCE for students appearing in ICSE Class 10 board exam.The timetable include the dates and timings for subjects such as English, Mathematics, Science, History & Civics, Geography, second language and elective subjects.

 ISC Date Sheet 2027
 ISC date sheet 2027 will be released for students appearing in Science, Commerce and Humanities streams. The timetable will mention the date and timing of each examination.  ICSE, ISC Date Sheet 2027: Preparation Tips 
 Some of the preparation tips for ICSE, ISC exams 2027 are given below.
 Make a subject-wise study plan
 Practise specimen question papers and previous-year papers
 Complete the syllabus well before exam
 Keep a track of performance and get all the doubts sorted
 Maintain a notebook of the important points that you can refer to just before exam
